statement: You are given a string text. A subsequence is what remains after deleting zero or more characters without changing the order of the rest.
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards.
Return the length of the longest subsequence of text that is a palindrome.

examples.explanation: Dropping the "a" leaves "bbbb", a palindrome of length 4.
"bb" is the longest palindromic subsequence. No three of the letters read the same in both directions.

constraints: text contains only lowercase English letters
